_meta.what: Water/land ground truth for the 501-point regional-scan grid, used to test the Sentinel-2 buffer water mask. NOT a bloom-event dataset.
_meta.not_hab_events: This file contains no bloom observations and is used only for water-mask regression testing.
_meta.grid: generate_scan_grid(5) output, 501 points, 30 m sample buffer (DEFAULT_BUFFER_M) at 10 m scale -- the same geometry _resolve_sentinel2_scene samples.
_meta.truth_source: NDWI = (B3 - B8) / (B3 + B8), from each pixel's clearest observation in 2025-11-01..2026-04-30, selected by Cloud Score+ qualityMosaic on cs_cdf. is_water = ndwi > 0.
_meta.why_not_scl: Sentinel-2 SCL class 6 (WATER) was tried first and rejected: at points 4_9 and 5_9 (ETOPO1 -10 m, ~10 km offshore) the clearest observation is SCL 'thin cirrus', so class 6 is never assigned and an SCL-majority rule labels deep water as land. Measured NIR/green there: 0.03 and 0.00. NDWI is a physical contrast and does not depend on a per-scene classifier.
_meta.excluded: 2 of 501 points dropped as unmeasurable -- 4_15 and 4_17 returned B3 = 0 and B8 = 0 in the composite, making NDWI 0/0.
_meta.known_ambiguity: 23_10 (Chao Phraya river mouth) is NDWI -0.220 but JRC reports 30/30 water. A real tidal mudflat; the current mask admits it and so does the proposed one. Documented, not resolved.
_meta.reference_columns: jrc_occ_valid/jrc_occ_water are JRC GSW occurrence pixel counts in the buffer (jrc_occ_valid < buffer_px means JRC has no data there); etopo_m is NOAA ETOPO1 bedrock elevation; mod44w is MODIS MOD44W water_mask; worldcover is ESA WorldCover v200 class (80 = permanent water). These are candidate mask inputs, not truth.
_meta.regenerate: See the sweep/probe scripts referenced in the water-mask investigation; requires live GEE auth.
